## What it is
Vault Pipeline is the VaultSpark Studios public development roadmap. It tracks what is shipping, what is in the forge, and what is queued for the next cycle. Transparent development — every milestone visible. The page streams recent commits and updates live from the GitHub activity feed.

## Current focus
Ongoing — live streaming of project activity and build cadence across all VaultSpark titles and tools.

## Next milestone
Continuous — the pipeline reflects real-time studio activity as projects move through Forge, Sparked, and Vaulted status.
